column8: ["The broad ivory sheet reads as a backing plate beneath the seats, making the object feel like a perforated tray rather than a built machine.","The rings read as soft terracotta and teal stains; darkened brass, matte rubber and glossy ceramic lack distinct surface character.","Identical rounded sockets and large blank expanses make the painting feel timid and diagrammatic; it needs more confident fabrication detail and contact-edge wear."]
